subject: ventures/einvoice-preflight
auditor: agent session (Claude), independent re-audit; see run record
professional: an e-invoicing integration consultant who certifies ERP output against EN 16931, Peppol BIS 3.0 and XRechnung validators; first check: does the pre-screen agree to the cent with BR-CO-15/16/17, and are its identifier check digits the published algorithms

evidence.correctness: Prior defect re-run, still present. In ventures/einvoice-preflight: node -e import checks.mjs; roundHalfUpToCents(1.5*19/100) (1.5*19/100 evaluates to 0.285) returns 0.28, exact half-up is 0.29; roundHalfUpToCents(1.005) returns 1 (1.005*100 = 100.49999999999999), exact half-up of the decimal 1.005 is 1.01. checks.mjs:31 and linenet.mjs:17 are unchanged: Math.round(abs*100 + Number.EPSILON). No commit since 2026-11-07 touched them (git log shows only #14052, #14020, #14001, all VAT/doc). NEW WORK, recomputed by hand in Python from the published algorithms, not from the repo: Norway organisasjonsnummer (brreg): weights 3,2,7,6,5,4,3,2 over 8 digits, check = 11 - sum mod 11, 11 -> 0, 10 -> never issued. 923609016 -> 6 (matches; brreg API data.brreg.no returns EQUINOR ASA, registered for MVA, so a real-world valid number), 914778271 -> 1, 974760673 -> 3 (brreg API returns a record), 982463718 -> 8, 889640782 -> 2: all match and the tool accepts them with or without MVA, spaces. Switzerland UID (eCH-0097): weights 5,4,3,2,7,6,5,4, same check rule. 116281710 -> 0 and 109322551 -> 1 match the tool and 101362800/100000000 are correctly rejected INV-023. I could not confirm that any Swiss number is a live registered UID: uid.admin.ch and zefix are JavaScript apps that returned no company text through the proxy, so the Swiss check is verified against the spec only, not a real-register number. The test fixture CHE-116.281.710 was therefore not independently confirmed as a real entity. Algorithms are right. Edge cases: NO000000000MVA is accepted (all-zero is arithmetically valid, never issued; low). JS-only: the Python port has no NO/CH (see craft). Correctness stays 2: the primary-path rounding error is unfixed one day later.
evidence.completeness: README/ROADMAP claims checked: UBL/CII/Factur-X/JSON readers, INV-001..035, IBAN/BIC/VAT/period/means/terms/remittance, profiles, repair, generate, country mandate pages: all covered by tests that pass (JS 1286 pass, 0 fail, 50 skipped; Python 359 pass, 53 subtests). New NO/CH VAT checks work end to end through inspectPartyVat (ran 12 inputs: MVA/MWST suffixes, dots, dashes, wrong suffix -> INV-022, bad digit -> INV-023). Stated limits confirmed: Schematron route skipped without slimdom/fontoxpath, PDF/A unrun, Python lacks profiles. No stubs found.
evidence.verification: Ran `node --test '*.test.mjs'` in ventures/einvoice-preflight: 1336 tests, 1286 pass, 0 fail, 50 skipped. `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests`: 359 passed, 53 subtests. Mutations (each reverted with git checkout, my files clean): (1) vat.mjs Swiss last weight 4 -> 5: vat.test.mjs failed (caught). (2) vat.mjs removed the `check !== 10 &&` guard in mod11Check (accepting numbers whose check would be 10): the entire 1336-test suite still passed, SURVIVED: the 'never issued' rule the comment documents has no test. (3) checks.mjs `dueDate < issueDate` -> `<=`: checks.test.mjs failed (caught). The half-cent rounding defect passes every test (no tie-case test exists) and JS/Python are still not checked against a shared fixture corpus. The new NO/CH test has two valid and two invalid numbers per country but only one Norwegian number and one Swiss number; weights of the Norwegian algorithm were not mutated (not run). The prior low finding (INV-011 boundary) not re-run.
evidence.craft: Read vat.mjs diff #14052 and the new mod11Check (compact, one shared helper for two countries, good comment), checks.mjs:25-35, linenet.mjs:10-20. The float-rounding defect found yesterday is unfixed. NEW: the Python port src/einvoice_preflight/vat.py has no Norway or Switzerland entries (CY/MT were ported, NO/CH were not), so the same invoice now gets INV-022/023 findings in JS and none in Python: parity drift is growing, not shrinking, and nothing in the process (no shared fixtures) detects it. classify() in vat.mjs hard-codes NO and CH special cases ahead of the FORMAT_ONLY table instead of using the EXTRA_CHECKS table CY/MT used, a third pattern for the same job. Positives unchanged: small modules, rule ids with fixes, defensive inputs.
evidence.claims: Checks.mjs header still claims the page and CLI report 'the same rule IDs, messages, and cent-rounded arithmetic': false (rounding ties differ; NO/CH VAT findings exist only in JS). The prior audit flagged this; unfixed, no README/header change. Honest items verified again: 'observation, not the KoSIT validator'; stage prototype with untested hypotheses in VENTURE.yaml; disclaimer in index.html and llms.txt; VAT checks described as from public descriptions. The new post docs/posts/2026-11-08-einvoice-preflight-norway-switzerland-vat.md makes narrow claims consistent with my recomputation. Score drops to 2 because a known false parity claim persisted after being reported.
evidence.fitness: Walked a bookkeeper's job again with the NO/CH numbers: a Norwegian supplier ID typed with spaces and MVA passes, one wrong digit gets a fixed message INV-023. Useful for EHF/Peppol traders and Swiss suppliers. Still the browser/API path can flag a correct invoice on roughly 1 in 1,000 tax computations; Python CLI users get no NO/CH check at all.
evidence.domain: Norwegian organisasjonsnummer and Swiss UID mod-11 are exactly as published (Brreg; eCH-0097), including the check-10 exclusion and the MVA/MWST/TVA/IVA suffix handling. EN 16931 BR-CO-15/16/17 arithmetic is right except tie rounding. A consultant would accept it as a pre-screen, not a substitute for the official Schematron, which the README says. One gap: Norway numbers never start with 0 and Swiss UID number ranges are not checked, so an all-zero id passes; small.

defects.what: Unfixed from 2026-11-07: roundHalfUpToCents/roundCents use Math.round(abs*100 + Number.EPSILON). 1.5*19/100 = 0.285 rounds to 0.28 (exact 0.29); 1.005 rounds to 1 (exact 1.01). Correct invoices can draw false INV-018/INV-012/INV-014 in the browser page and API; the Python port does not.

New JS/Python parity gap: Norwegian and Swiss VAT check digits (#14052) exist only in vat.mjs; src/einvoice_preflight/vat.py has no NO or CH. The header claim that both engines report the same rule IDs is false and nothing tests it.
Removing the `check !== 10` guard in mod11Check survives all 1336 JS tests: the 'check 10 is never issued' rule has no test.
Swiss UID check was verified only against the spec; the fixture number CHE-116.281.710 is not shown to be a real registered UID, and an all-zero Norwegian number NO000000000MVA passes the check.
Three different structures now implement country VAT checks (EXTRA_CHECKS table, inline if-chains in classify and checksumOk, FORMAT_ONLY table); NO/CH bypass the table CY/MT use.

Carried over: 50 Schematron/CIUS tests skip without slimdom and fontoxpath; README is a 110 KB run log with templated country pages committed as source; INV-011 boundary mutation untested (not re-run).

verdict: Independent re-audit one day after the first. The Norwegian and Swiss check-digit work is correct: I recomputed the published mod-11 algorithms by hand, Equinor's 923609016 (confirmed live in the Brreg register) and four other numbers match, and 1336 JS and 359 Python tests pass. But the previous audit's main defect, the half-cent rounding in checks.mjs and linenet.mjs, was not fixed (0.285 still rounds to 0.28), the false JS/Python parity claim is unchanged, and the new work widened the parity gap because the Python port got no NO/CH. A seeded mutation removing the check-10 guard survived the suite (a Swiss weight mutation was caught). Does not meet the bar (correctness 2, verification 2, claims 2). Scores are before any fix.
